title: GTA 6 is NOT a Masterpiece
desc: 99 out of 100 - that is the Metacritic score for Grand Theft Auto 6 - making it the highest rated game of all-time. Personally I’ve been having a lot of fun playing it so far. And I can see myself getting lost in this game for potentially hundreds of hours. It is a great game.
